description: Continue & finish: send a crew waiting at its HIL gate back to the engineer with guidance — it resumes work on the SAME PR (capped at the amend limit). This is the "Continue" option alongside submit_approval APPROVE (ship) / REJECT (stop). A crew halted at its ship gate is resumed with the notes; refused with pr_merged or pr_closed when its pull request merged or closed after the halt. A crew already running is not refused: the amend is queued (queued: true) and appliesAt says when: next_step (the Engineer reads it before its next step) or ship_card (held on its next ship card as a pending Resume, sent from there). A finished crew is refused with no_pending_approval and a nextStep. Requires `approve` scope. Only call when the operator explicitly asks to amend/continue — never on your own judgement of the reviews.

crewId.description: The crew id (the crew must be at a pending approval gate).

notes.description: What the engineer should finish/change — becomes the amend instruction.

postToPullRequest.description: Also post the notes on the crew's pull request as a comment review, where everyone with access to the repository can read them. Omit to follow the company setting, which is off unless an owner turned it on. Only set true when the operator asks for the notes to appear on the pull request.

name: anyforge_amend_crew
